brief: Counts in cycles: it starts at a number, steps by a number, and starts over when a limit is reached or after a number of values.
detail: Give it a hashlist of options and ask for the first N numbers. :WhenYouReach names the value at which the count restarts, :AfterYouSkip names how many values to skip before it restarts, and :RestartAt is the value it restarts from. The options :StartAt and :Step alone are not enough today: without one of the two cycle options every number comes out as 0.
